116-4613-6859.easyPrerequisites:

116-4613-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping Servant of Tymaret
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

687-2511-5004--73.easyPrerequisites: The creature with persist or undying doesn't  have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it respective to its ability.
687-2511-5004--73.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing  both counters from your persist/undying creature and one counter from another creature, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-3081-3817-7772.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2104-6927-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2665-4004-7149.description:
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Progenitor Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Progenitor Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Progenitor Mimic enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Progenitor Mimic leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Progenitor Mimic from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat.

Repeat.

1878-2713-3454-4539-6005.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Malevolent Chandelier twice by paying {2}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Gain life.

When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.

Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.

When Evil Twin enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Evil Twin. Choose to have Evil Twin enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.

1339-2034-2122-3062.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, giving creatures you control deathtouch until end of turn and putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature token you control.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

You have a way to give Nomads en-Kor indestructible.
You have a way to target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
220-428-1946-2719.description:
Give Nomads en-Kor indestructible, if needed, and then target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Repeat step 2 until only 1 damage will be dealt to Nomads en-Kor.
Resolve the spell or ability, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and any remaining damage to Brash Taunter.
Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger for the damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, along with Brash Taunter. Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces also trigger for the damage dealt to Brash Taunter if exactly 1 damage  was dealt to it.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve both Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 2 damage to Nomads en-Kor, and 2 damage to Brash Taunter, if applicable.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, if applicable, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers twice, and Brash Taunter triggers once.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger from step 13, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor in step 13, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter and 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor.
Repeat from step 13 one additional time, with the nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggering instead of Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat from step 13.
